reference.title: Firewall support for AWS IP ranges
reference.shortdesc: The leverages the AWS Cloud to provide scalable and reliable Internet-of-Things (IoT) connectivity. :

section.p: The leverages the AWS Cloud to provide scalable and reliable Internet-of-Things (IoT) connectivity. :

AWS publishes the complete list of AWS IP ranges used by their cloud services at https://ip-ranges.amazonaws.com/ip-ranges.json. This list is dynamic, and the IP addresses change periodically. Your Network Administrator can subscribe to notifications about changes and apply these to maintain your network firewall configuration. Access full details at https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-ip-ranges.html
